body:
* **InterPro ID / label**
IPR016193 Cytidine deaminase-like


* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**



* **Description of issue**
This is a superfamily, with the description "This superfamily represents a structural domain..."
So I don't think it's appropriate to annotate with the top level term "catalytic activity" (which isn't so useful anyway).

Also, there is at least one protein with this signature that is non-catalytic - https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q96EY9/entry
title: IPR016193 Cytidine deaminase-like
